8.
ZX Limited has total assets of ` 7,20,000 and its Shareholders' equity is
` 4,50,000. The net profit margin of ZX Limited is 12.5% and asset turnover
ratio is 1.5. Using the DuPont model, the return on equity of ZX Limited is
calculated as :
(A)
7.03%
(B)
50%
(C)
11.72%
(D)
30%
